newsitem.title: UK: Dlr edges above 1.64 marks in late Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dlr edges above 1.64 marks in late Europe.

text.p: The dollar nosed above 1.64 marks in late European trade, but dealers said trade was thin and rangebound conditions were likely to continue.
The market seemed reluctant to retest the multi-year highs reached last week and was catching its breath before a possible attempt higher, dealers said.
"It should stay rangebound for the next couple of days," said a dealer at a Swiss bank in London.
Data expected later this week could provide a signal for the dollar to break out of its current ranges.
